benefitsSection.title: What you get working with us.
benefitsSection.lead: AI accelerates delivery, while engineers ensure quality through code review, testing, and 1-week Scrum cadence. Learn more in our [Rules to Better AI-Assisted Development](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/rules-to-better-ai-assisted-development).

items.title: Faster delivery
items.description: AI handles the repetitive parts of coding, so features that used to take weeks land in days. The review and testing still happen — they don't get skipped to hit a date.

items.title: Enterprise-grade quality
items.description: Every change goes through code review and automated tests, with a senior consultant keeping an eye on the architecture and security.

items.title: Seamless communication
items.description: Your Scrum Master is based in North America and runs standups, Sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates during your working hours.

items.title: Scrum-led delivery
items.description: We work in 1-week Sprints and show you working software at the end of each one. You can see what's done, what's next, and roughly when it'll be ready.

items.title: Flexible team structure
items.description: Add senior architects or more engineers when the work picks up, and scale back when it quiets down. You're not locked into a fixed headcount.

items.title: Cost-effective scaling
items.description: Mix senior oversight with a more affordable delivery team, so you're not paying architect rates for every line of code.

servicesSection.title: From prototype to production
servicesSection.lead: Whether it is a rough idea or a long-term platform, the same senior people and process see it through.

items.title: AI-assisted software development
items.description: Build applications faster with [AI-assisted](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/ai-assisted-development-workflow) specs, code, QA, and review, guided by senior engineers.

items.title: Legacy app modernization
items.description: Modernize aging .NET, WinForms, and on-prem systems piece by piece, without stopping the business.

items.title: Custom business applications
items.description: Internal tools shaped around your workflow and connected to the systems you already use.

items.title: Technical consulting and architecture
items.description: Senior architects help you make the right technical calls early, while they are still easy to change.

howSection.title: A predictable path from first conversation to live software.

rows.title: Senior teams, sized to fit

paragraphs.text: SSW is for CTOs and technology leaders who need to modernize, build, or scale critical software without waiting months to hire a full team.

items.question: How should I choose an AI-assisted software development partner?

paragraphs.text: Pick a partner that has actually shipped software, not just demos. Look for solid engineering habits, open communication, and senior people who stick around for the whole build.
The tools matter less than how a team uses them. We pair AI with 30+ years of consulting experience, so you get the speed without losing the accountability.

items.question: What are the benefits of working with SSW versus building in-house?

paragraphs.text: Hiring senior engineers takes months. We can start in about two weeks with a full team — engineers, a Scrum Master, and an architect — so there's no recruiting drag and no bad-hire risk on something that matters.
You own the code, the IP, and the way it was built. When you're ready to take it in-house, we hand it over cleanly.

items.question: How does SSW combine AI speed with enterprise quality?

paragraphs.text: With process. AI speeds up the typing, not the thinking. Every change goes through the same steps — spec, code review, automated test, staged deploy — with senior engineers involved the whole way.
So it ships quickly and keeps working after it does.
